description: 16-mer conservation profile of the gataE locus between S. purpuratus and L. variegatus, with conserved patches and motif content
code:
import re,numpy as np,pandas as pd,matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def rd(c): return open(f"out/{c}.fa").read().strip()
def rc(s): return s[::-1].translate(str.maketrans("ACGTN","TGCAN"))
K=16
sp=rd("gatae_win"); lvs=rd("Lvar_gatae_big"); lv=lvs+"N"+rc(lvs)
LV={lv[i:i+K] for i in range(len(lv)-K+1) if "N" not in lv[i:i+K]}
hit=np.array([1 if sp[i:i+K] in LV else 0 for i in range(len(sp)-K+1)],np.int8)
W=300; step=25
cs=np.concatenate([[0],np.cumsum(hit)]); starts=np.arange(0,len(hit)-W,step)
score=(cs[starts+W]-cs[starts])/W
print("K=16 chance expectation %.2e ; observed median %.4f  99th %.4f  max %.4f"%(2*len(lvs)/4**K,np.median(score),np.percentile(score,99),score.max()))
TSS=20000
cons=starts[score>0.10]
patches=[]; cur=None
for s in cons:
    if cur is None: cur=[s,s]
    elif s-cur[1]<=W: cur[1]=s
    else: patches.append(cur); cur=[s,s]
if cur: patches.append(cur)
rows=[]
for a,b in patches:
    seg=sp[a:b+W]
    rows.append(dict(start_rel_TSS=a-TSS,end_rel_TSS=b+W-TSS,bp=b+W-a,
        max_frac_16mer=round(float(score[(starts>=a)&(starts<=b)].max()),3),
        ATGCGGRY=len(re.findall("(?=(ATGCGG[AG][CT]))",seg))+len(re.findall("(?=([AG][CT]CCGCAT))",seg)),
        ATGCGG_core=len(re.findall("(?=(ATGCGG))",seg))+len(re.findall("(?=(CCGCAT))",seg))))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("max_frac_16mer",ascending=False)
df.to_csv("out/gatae_conserved_patches.csv",index=False)
print(f"\n{len(patches)} conserved non-coding patches (>=10% of 16-mers shared with L. variegatus), {int(df.bp.sum())} bp of {len(sp)}")
print(df.head(30).to_string(index=False))
print("\nATGCGGRY inside any conserved patch:",int(df.ATGCGGRY.sum()))
print("ATGCGG core inside any conserved patch:",int(df.ATGCGG_core.sum()))
print("candidate -12448 (offset 7552) inside a conserved patch?",any(a<=7552<=b+W for a,b in patches))
print("local 16-mer conservation at the candidate: %.3f"%score[np.argmin(np.abs(starts-(7552-150)))])
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,3.6))
ax.fill_between((starts+W/2-TSS)/1000,score,color="#4a7ba7",lw=0)
for a,b in patches: ax.axvspan((a-TSS)/1000,(b+W-TSS)/1000,color="#f1c40f",alpha=.35,lw=0)
ax.axvline((7552-TSS)/1000,color="#e67e22",lw=2)
ax.annotate("only ATGCGGRY in the locus\n(-12448, ATGCGGAT, 5.09 bits)",((7552-TSS)/1000,score.max()*0.85),
            xytext=(12,0),textcoords="offset points",color="#e67e22",fontsize=9,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#e67e22"))
ax.axvline(0,color="k",ls=":"); ax.text(0,score.max()*1.02,"gataE TSS",fontsize=8,ha="center")
ax.set_xlabel("position relative to the S. purpuratus gataE transcription start (kb)")
ax.set_ylabel("fraction of 16-mers\nshared with L. variegatus")
ax.set_title("Sp/Lv conserved patches across the gataE regulatory domain contain no GCM consensus site",fontsize=11,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
